description: Lists the Citation Scans in the connected account, newest first. A Citation Scan asks a fixed set of buyer questions in one category and country across several AI answer engines and records which websites the answers cite. Each item has its id, the website scanned (target_domain), category, country, status (pending_payment, paid, running, completed, failed or cancelled), client_id, the Diagnostic it started from (diagnostic_report_id), created and completed dates, and once completed the share of answered cells that cited the website (target_share, 0 to 1) and how many answer cells were filled (populated_cells). Filters: client_id and status. An empty page means none were returned for these filters, not that the account has none or that Yellowhead does not offer the scan.
